mainEntity.name: How does Immigrate to Brazil handle your information if I contact the team?

acceptedAnswer.text: We handle your information with care, clear internal boundaries, and the aim of using only what is reasonably needed to review or support your enquiry.

mainEntity.name: What information do I usually need to share to get help?

acceptedAnswer.text: That depends on your situation. Usually, the first step is a short practical summary, not every possible document or detail all at once.

mainEntity.name: Can I ask questions before sending sensitive details?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. If you are unsure what to share first, contact the team and explain that you want to understand the safest way to proceed.

mainEntity.name: Does Immigrate to Brazil share my information automatically?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Information is not treated casually. Any sharing should be tied to the service context and handled with clear purpose and care.

mainEntity.name: How can I ask for clarification about your information?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can contact the team directly if you need more clarity about how your information is handled or what is appropriate to send at the current stage.
